_description: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II) shared configuration. Single source of truth for ALL biomechanical thresholds, loaded by BOTH the Python implementation (warrior2_tracker.py, warrior2_image.py) and the JavaScript implementation (warrior2_engine.js via app.js). Changing a value here changes both engines identically - this is the Python<->JS connection.

head._description: Head/nose alignment relative to shoulder midpoint. max_offset is the ratio of |nose_x - mid_shoulder_x| * aspect / torso_len (shoulder-to-hip distance). Torso length is used instead of shoulder width for robustness: it is stable regardless of arm position or body rotation. Allows natural head movement while catching excessive forward/backward lean. min_visibility is the minimum nose landmark visibility for the head check to be evaluated.
